senses.gloss:
√cat (?) 'hide'
present: [1.] cátant 
[perfect: cacāta cete ]
aorist: [3.] acīcatam acīcate -- [5.] acatīt acatiṣṭa 
[future: catiṣyati catiṣyate catitā ]
verbal: cattá 
secondary: causative: cātayati cātayate 
derivatives: -cát catín RV. -cā́tana V. -catnuka? AB. 
The words cātaka C., catura C., cattra or cāttra C. probably do not belong to this root.
